description: Shorten a .docx to a target word count, keeping meaning, structure and citations. Saves the result next to the source and returns its path. COSTS CREDITS at 100 per 1,000 words processed (10 minimum) - say so and get agreement first.

max_words.description: Target word count for the whole document

output_path.description: Where to write the result; defaults to beside the source

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before returning a job id (default 55)

name: condense_document
title: Condense a document
